sentences.text:
By the present petition, the petitioner / accused takes exception to the judgment and order dated 09.08.2019, passed in Criminal Revision No.92 of 2016, by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-4,
Parbhani and thereby affirmed the order dated 19.05.2016, passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Court No.4, Parbhani in R.C.C. No.630 of 2012, whereby the process against the present petitioner / accused issued for the offence punishable under Sections 420 and 468 of I.P.C.
3.

It is the case of respondent No.2 / complainant that, the present petitioner / accused is his sister-in-law i.e. wife of his elder brother and she has prepared false and bogus documents with an intention to receive the financial benefits from the Government under the scheme of "Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana".
4. The petitioner / accused is residing at Nandgaon (Kh), Tq. and Dist. Parbhani.
She has prepared the false and bogus documents in her maiden name and shown herself as a daughter of Maroti Kale.

The husband of the petitioner / accused has died on 04.06.2007, but she has prepared false documents showing Shri. Maroti Sitaram Kale as her father and produced the false death certificate of her husband.

After perusal of the complaint, affidavit verification, police report as well as the evidence produced on record, the learned Judicial Magistrate has satisfied about making prima facie case against the accused for issuance of process for the offence punishable under Section 420 and 468 of I.P.C., hence process was issued against the petitioner vide order dated 19.05.2016.
6. Being aggrieved by order dated 19.05.2016, the present petitioner / accused had filed Criminal Revision No.92 of 2016 before the learned Sessions Court, Parbhani.

On 09.08.2019, the learned Additional Sessions Judge, passed the impugned order holding that, the allegations made in the complaint about the petitioner, obtaining the benefit under the scheme of " Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana", by submitting different documents as well as submitting the forged death certificate of her husband and representing herself as orphan to receive the financial aid from the Government under the scheme of "Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana".

Therefore, as per the provisions of Section 39 of Cr.P.C., every person is having duty to initiate criminal proceeding and as such, the complainant has made out prima facie ground to proceed against the petitioner / accused for the said offence.

Therefore, I do find that the findings recorded by the learned Revisional Court while affirming the order dated 19.05.2016 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class in R.C.C. No.630 of 2012, are based on material available on record and no substantial grounds are set out to interfere in the said findings.
Hence, the Writ Petition is dismissed.
Rule discharged.
8. Record and proceedings be remitted back to the trial Court.
9. The trial of R.C.C. No. 630 of 2012 is expedited; however, the present petitioner/accused will have all defenses available.
